probe_description: Object-search-only probe (curve eligibility scan, no subgroup enumeration), executed separately from the full worker attempt to obtain concrete timing/scale evidence before deciding whether the full instrumented run (subgroup enumeration + C1/C2/C5/C6 passes) was feasible within this session's practical wall-clock budget.

full_worker_attempt.reason: The full instrumented worker (subgroup enumeration of the order-N=5,230,261 subgroup of the first eligible curve via repeated elliptic-curve point addition in pure Sage/Python, followed by multiple additional full-N passes for the C2 non-stable-subspace membership test per distinct slot dimension) did not complete within a 540-second self-imposed wall-clock checkpoint. Extrapolating from the throughput observed on the completed core cells (~7,000-8,000 point additions/second including per-point membership classification), a single full pass over N=5,230,261 points alone is on the order of 650-750 seconds, before the several repeated full passes C2 requires per distinct achievable slot dimension (2, 4, and 6 in this cell) and before the second curve (N=3,109, cheap) and the C4 null-curve construction (which itself requires an independent point-counting call over a 62,748,517-element field). The aggregate cost was judged infeasible to complete within this session's practical execution budget.
full_worker_attempt.classification: resource_exhaustion (per AGENTS.md core rule 5 / agents/executor.md failure taxonomy): infrastructure/scheduling outcome, not a mathematical result. Per specification.yaml SR-4, FROB-EXT-q13n7 is the ordered-last, explicitly non-load-bearing extension cell whose non-completion for resource reasons is a permitted terminal state (not_run_resource) that does not affect the success or falsification criteria, all of which are scoped to the three named core cells.
full_worker_attempt.note_on_memory: The attempt never approached the 8 GiB machine-protection cap (peak observed RSS during the attempt was well under 300 MB); the checkpoint was purely a wall-clock scheduling decision, not a memory exhaustion event.

cell_status_reason: Self-imposed wall-clock checkpoint reached before the full subgroup enumeration and its required repeated C2 passes could complete; permitted under SR-4 for this ordered-last, non-load-bearing extension cell.
